address: place de la Résistance 1, Baudour, 7331, Belgium
bio: Pull up a chair on the delightful terrace and enjoy the lively and infectious ambience of the Faitout. The menu features traditional recipes: Ardennes pork, grilled meats, country terrines and seafood platters… Authenticity and generosity above all else! Take your pick from the varied choice on the menu (with a range of prices), you won’t be disappointed. Open 7 days a week!...
